name: supplies
description: Reusable practical objects for travel, exploration, professions, and everyday adventuring

fields.name: Coil of rope
fields.description: Ten meters of sturdy rope for climbing, binding, or securing loads.

fields.name: Lantern and oil
fields.description: A hooded lantern with enough oil for several hours.

fields.name: Waterskin
fields.description: A filled leather waterskin.

fields.name: Bedroll
fields.description: A weather-resistant blanket and sleeping roll.

fields.name: Tinderbox
fields.description: Flint, steel, and dry tinder for starting fires.

fields.name: Lockpicking kit
fields.description: Small tools for manipulating ordinary mechanical locks.

fields.name: Climbing kit
fields.description: Pitons, a hammer, straps, and simple climbing aids.

fields.name: Chalk and charcoal
fields.description: Useful for marking paths, sketching maps, and making notes.

fields.name: Small mirror
fields.description: A polished hand mirror useful for signals and checking corners.

fields.name: Crowbar
fields.description: A sturdy iron lever for doors, crates, and obstacles.

fields.name: Grappling hook
fields.description: A four-pronged hook designed for use with rope.

fields.name: Fishing kit
fields.description: Line, hooks, floats, and a compact net.

fields.name: Writing kit
fields.description: Ink, quills, parchment, sealing wax, and a protective case.

fields.name: Herbalism pouch
fields.description: Small tools and containers for gathering useful plants.

fields.name: Shovel
fields.description: A compact but sturdy digging tool.

fields.name: Bear trap
fields.description: A heavy mechanical trap capable of restraining a creature.

fields.name: Disguise kit
fields.description: Cosmetics, dyes, false hair, and simple costume pieces.

fields.name: Merchant's scale
fields.description: A folding balance and reference weights for checking trade goods.

fields.name: Bag of caltrops
fields.description: Sharp metal spikes used to slow pursuit or secure a passage.

fields.name: Spyglass
fields.description: A compact optical tube for viewing distant details.

fields.name: Tent
fields.description: A small shelter suitable for one or two travelers.

fields.name: Manacles
fields.description: A pair of iron restraints with a simple key.

fields.name: Holy symbol
fields.description: A symbol tied to a faith, oath, ancestor, or personal ideal.

fields.name: Local map
fields.description: A practical but imperfect map of the surrounding region.

fields.name: Silvered chain
fields.description: A short chain useful against creatures vulnerable to silver.

fields.name: Runic chalk
fields.description: Rare chalk that makes magical inscriptions easier to see and study.

fields.name: Excavation Tools
fields.description: A hook, small pick, and folding shovel for searching or crossing difficult ground.

fields.name: Musical Instrument
fields.description: A portable lute, drum, violin, or other worn but functional instrument.

fields.name: Quality Paper
fields.description: Blank sheets and parchment suited to contracts, maps, spells, or forged documents.
